03

How the numbers are produced

Weights are bits, not labels

Q4_K_M is not 4 bits per weight — block scales make it about 4.83. Every estimate uses effective bits, so a 70B Q4 model comes out at 42 GB rather than 35.

KV cache is not optional

Cache scales with layers × KV heads × context. At 128K tokens a 70B model needs roughly 40 GB of cache at FP16, which is more than most cards.

Prices are list prices

Batch discounts, provisioned throughput and regional rates are excluded. Treat results as planning figures accurate to about ±15%.

Read the full methodology →
Memory formulaGB

weights = params × bits / 8 / 1024³

kv = 2 × layers × kv_heads × head_dim × bytes × tokens

overhead = 1.5 GB (runtime reserve)

total = weights + kv + overhead
fit = total ≤ memory × usable_ratio

Example: 70B Q4 · 8K ctx · 409043.4 / 21.6
